name: verinoda-live
description: Verinoda in Claude Code: the Verinoda MCP server's tools listed in front of the model with a one-paragraph call rule, the code index kept fresh while Claude edits, an optional check of each edit for names that do not exist, an improvement list for you to choose from (/verinoda-improve), and a Turkish pane with an animated mascot.

root.title: Project folder
root.description: The folder with the .verinoda index. Empty: the nearest folder at or above the one the session starts in; one found above the session's folder is used only when `verinoda trust` knows it.

cli.title: Verinoda CLI
cli.description: Path to the verinoda program, or its name on PATH. Empty: verinoda on PATH outside the project. A program inside the project (its .venv, say) is never run; when PATH has none outside it, nothing runs until this names one.

check.title: Check each edit
check.description: After each edit of a Python, Java or Kotlin file, tell Claude the names on the changed lines that do not exist in the project or its environment. Off: nothing runs after an edit (measured: 0 notes in 65 edits). /verinoda-check changes it for the session and later ones.

improveOffer.title: Offer the improvement list
improveOffer.description: When a request says "better" or "nicer" without saying what, Claude offers the improvement list instead of guessing. Off: the list comes only with /verinoda-improve.

motion.title: Animated mascot
motion.description: Let the pane's mascot blink and move. Off: it stands still.
